author: Aurora Crate Book Box
title: Looking for artists available through end of 2026
content: We’re looking for some artists with availability between now and the end of 2026. Self recs welcome, please include price list + some examples. No dms please. Also to clarify, NO AI - human artists only please.

author: Rian
title: Artists wanted for upcoming projects and character design
content: ARTISTS WANTED — OPEN TO NEW OPPORTUNITIES 🎨 I’m currently searching for talented artists to connect with for potential upcoming projects and creative opportunities. I’m interested in meeting people with a range of artistic skills, from digital illustration and character design to traditional artwork and other visual styles. If you have a portfolio that showcases your creativity and approach to your craft, I’d love to take a look. If this sounds like something you’d be interested in, please send me a DM with examples of your work and a little information about your artistic background. Please feel free to share this post with any artists who might be interested. Thank you!

author: CALOY ANIMATION
title: Looking for illustrator or digital artist
content: I’m looking for an illustrator or digital artist! ✨ If you’re interested, DM me your portfolio along with your rates. Let’s work together! 💌 Paid work opportunities for illustration, character art, concept art, portraits, graphic art—open to different styles. Reply with your portfolio or message me directly.

author: Nico Silver Books
title: Call for illustrators for upcoming project
content: New acquisitions announcement coming soon...and a call for illustrators. 👀 Do NOT DM me and do NOT email any of our accounts in regards for our search for an illustrator. This is for a specific project and we will have a submission link up soon. I apologise that was not made clear originally.
